title: Wholesome Sweet Saffron Mechoui Bento Box
description: A sweet and aerated Moroccan dish featuring russet potato and a soffritto base in an egg-free-friendly bento box format.
instructions: Peel and dice the russet potatoes into bite-sized chunks.
Mince the onion finely, then lightly sauté with the garlic clove until translucent.
Toast cumin seeds in a dry pan for about 30 seconds, stirring frequently.
Add coriander seeds to the pan and toast until fragrant. Remove from heat and set aside.
Mix together the saffron threads, 1 tablespoon of water, and the minced onion mixture. Let steep for at least 15 minutes.
Stir in the toasted cumin seeds and coriander into the saffron mix.
Blend in the diced pineapple until smooth.
Fold in the hummus and kalamata olives. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
Portion the mixture evenly among rice Krispies Treats for a bento box presentation.
